metric_definitions: Unit: distinct order. Eligible: delivered/completed with valid actual and promised duration. Durations: calendar days from order placement to customer delivery. Delay = actual - scheduled days; late > 0, on time <= 0. On-time rate = on-time eligible orders / eligible delivered orders. Same-calendar-day arrival is on time. Sales are aggregated once per order; currency is unspecified for uploads.
eligible_population: Delivered/completed orders with valid actual and scheduled delivery durations.
limitations: Historical observational data; associations are not causal. Cancelled, undelivered and unknown outcomes are excluded from delivery-rate denominators. Small groups are unstable. No measured savings, carrier quality, inventory efficiency or current service guarantees are inferred.
